cells.gaps: The sources disagree: the land reform secretary said in March 2025 that Ninacad-Adresse covers about 1,500,000 plots, but the tax directorate put the application at its design phase in January 2026. No source found says it is in service, nationwide or used by other services.
cells.note: Reassessed on a March 2025 report: the newest fact, the tax directorate's of January 2026, puts the addressing application at its design phase, so it stands at rung 2. Rung 3 needs a system in service, which the newer source does not say.
